description: A USB device is plugged in and, within 30 minutes, at least 20 files appear to have been copied into one person's own folders. UBA rules: usb_connected, storage drives only (details.storage: a USBStorageDevices entry, or a USBDevices entry enumerated under USBSTOR or with a storage driver - the LAST connection time of each device, and no account: a machine step; mice, webcams and hubs are left out) then file_copy_inferred ($MFT: created after last modified, in the person's Desktop / Documents / Downloads; grouped per folder per day and timed at the first copy). The copy rule sees files ARRIVING on this disk; copies made TO the USB drive are not recorded on this volume.
proves: Files appear to have been copied into a person's folders soon after a USB device was connected
author: Crow-Eye Team

steps.label: USB storage drive connected (no account recorded)
Files appear to have been copied

conditions.value: ^(?:the Desktop|the Documents folder|the Downloads folder|the Pictures folder|the Videos folder|the Music folder|the OneDrive folder)$
